name: RST00_JumpTable
comment: rst $00 with A=index ; dw table follows inline -> 06C4

name: RST18_FarCall
comment: rst $18 ; db idx bank -> 01B6 (same as rst $10)

name: RST30_TestFlag
comment: rst $30 ; dw flag<<5 -> NZ if set

name: FarCallHL
comment: A=bank HL=addr; restores bank on return

name: FarJumpTable
comment: A=bank HL=table B=index; ret if entry null

name: FarCallInline
comment: handler for rst $10/$18: reads db idx bank after rst; jumps to [bank:$4000+idx]

name: TestFlag_DE
comment: de: e=(flag&7)<<5 d=flag>>3 ; flags at wEventFlags

name: InitDMG
comment: farcall when not CGB (shows 'CGB only' screen?)

name: Decompress
comment: LZ: HL=src DE=dest; returns HL=size. see tools/decompress.py

name: ReadJoypad
comment: -> hJoyHeld $FF90 / hJoyPressed $FF94 / hJoyRepeat $FF91; A+B+Sel+Start = soft reset

name: PrintStringDebug
comment: HL=ASCII string DE=packed coords -> BG map (debug font)

name: SoundUpdate
comment: called each VBlank (and Timer ISR when LCD off)

name: wTextBuffer
comment: current message (max 160 B) copied from text bank

name: hJoyHeld
comment: bit0 A 1 B 2 Sel 3 Start 4 R 5 L 6 U 7 D

name: FieldScene
comment: RPG field: setup map wC281 + scripts then FieldLoop; returns on map exit (wC2A1)

name: CopyToVRAM
comment: HL=src DE=dst C=16B blocks; DE $A000-$BFFF = VRAM bank 1 (bit5 of D cleared); uses HDMA queue if LCD on

name: LoadBGPalettes
comment: HL=src D=first pal E=count -> wPalBuffer $C1xx and $C2xx

name: CopyBankTable
comment: H=bank L=idx DE=dst BC=len: raw copy of [bank:$4000+idx]

name: LoadMap
comment: A=map id (0-36): descriptor table 0A:59D9 (16 B each)

name: SpriteBankHeader
column9: ptr per-frame 4B table (same layout in banks 40-5D)

name: SpriteFramePtrs
comment: ptr per frame; frames 240 B (15 tiles) uncompressed 2bpp

name: MulSinCos
comment: signed multiply by sin/cos; angle in BC (+$40 = cos); table in bank 2D

name: DrawMeta24x32
comment: 6 x 8x16 OBJ column-major (E=y D=x C=tile B=attr; bit5 = X flip)

name: LoadCharacterSprites
comment: D=char id -> table 04:4F75 -> header copied to $DAD0

name: SRAM_Validate
comment: sig@A020 + checksum; on failure restore from bank 1 backup and recheck; else init

name: StrCmp
comment: DE vs HL null-terminated; NZ if different

name: CharTypeTable
comment: 32 x u8: 0 Power 1 Technique 2 All-Around 3 Tricky 4 Speed 5 ???

name: FieldLoop
comment: per frame: 0A:5104 input/move; 04:40AC actors (table 0A:4766); trigger flags wC2A0-wC2A5

name: FieldPlayerStep
comment: returns 0 when the field is paused (menu path 0A:50CA -> 04:415B)

name: wFieldInitHook
comment: far ptr called on field entry (bank wC29B)

name: CharRecords
comment: 32 x 29 B per roster char -> copied to wCA0E (P1) / wCA8E (P2); +18..+28 = 11 stats 0-9

name: CharColorSchemes
comment: 5 OBJ palettes; sprite header +0 (3..7) selects scheme (verified Luigi/Baby Mario)

name: wObjPalBuf
comment: 8 OBJ palettes (BG at C100); mirrored at C240
